messages:
Sara (CS): FYI Peridot Logistics opened a ticket: they want to onboard a custom NER for shipment summaries. requirements: tag routing codes (40 classes), addresses, and mask PHI. they require private VPC + HSM for keys. putting this here to triage.
Mike (SE): cool — do we have the model artifact? size/framework? perf targets?
Sara (CS): they emailed details: PyTorch fine-tuned seq2seq 7B (T5-style). trained on ~12k labeled manifests. target steady qps 30-60, p95 latency around 350ms acceptable. they insisted on deterministic masking for PII and asked for audit logs policy.
Priya (Privacy): we need to confirm data retention policy before they upload eval data. they only want de-identified evals and no long-term storage unless contracted. propose ephemeral eval runs and a results export.
Eli (SRE): infra quick take: 7B private -> recommend 2x A100-class nodes with int8 quant and prefix KV cache. fallback path to a 1-2B distil model is possible but will require output normalization for tag schema. cold cache penalties are real for manifests series.
Mike (SE): ask Peridot for a gold eval set (2k examples) with ground-truth tags and a per-class acceptance metric. recommend: per-class F1 >= 0.92 for routing codes, and FN for PII < 0.2%. also need to know if exact-token redaction is required or if token spans are OK.
Alex (AE): heads-up — if onboarding >8 weeks we should flag renewal cadence. i'll keep AE looped.
Jordan (Enablement): i'll set up an enablement + handoff call. agenda: onboarding checklist, eval harness demo, redaction approach, rollback/rollout plan, okrs for production. propose Tue 10am PT, sending invite once infra choice confirmed.
Sara (CS): Peridot asked if we support automatic fallback to hosted model during bursts to avoid downtime.
Eli (SRE): yes, policy-based routing doable in Private: route primary traffic to private model, overflow to dedicated/hosted fallback. must ensure fallback returns same tag schema; we'll implement a transform layer to normalize outputs. note: fallback in a different env may have compliance implications.
Mike (SE): config draft (will formalize):
```
model: peridot-ner-7b
deploy_mode: private_vpc
nodes: 2
quant: int8
caching: prefix_kv_enabled
security:
  kms: customer_hsm
  audit_retention_days: 90
routing:
  fallback: peridot-distil-1b
  policy: overflow_on_cpu_or_latency
rollout:
  canary: 5% for 48h
  ramp: 25% 72h -> 100%
  rollback_on: delta_F1 > 2pct on critical tags
```
Mike (SE): also recommend staged eval: run pre-deploy eval on their gold set, then live-canary eval logging for first 72h with automated quality checks.
Priya (Privacy): also capture the exact deletion/retention terms in SOW: ephemeral eval storage, logs only retained for 30-90 days depending on contract. need KMS SLA confirmation.
onboard-bot: created runbook -> /runbooks/onboarding/peridot-1971234567, owners: Sara (CS), Mike (SE), Eli (SRE), Priya (Privacy)
Sara (CS): action items:
- Mike: full deployment + eval config and acceptance criteria (due EOD Fri)
- Eli: capacity and fallback normalization plan (due Mon)
- Priya: draft privacy terms for eval/data retention (due Mon)
- Jordan: schedule enablement + cost ballpark (due Mon)
I'll request the gold eval set and their retention constraints. tagging @Alex for renewal visibility.
Alex (AE): noted. keep me posted on timeline and spend estimate.
Mike (SE): one more question to Peridot: do they need exact deterministic redaction (mask same token bytes) or is span-level masking acceptable? affects tokenizer-level postprocessing.
Sara (CS): i'll ask in the reply. thanks all :thumbsup:
